description: This file defines the interface for delta encoding/decoding functionalities, including creation and freeing of delta indexes, generating deltas between buffers, and applying deltas to recreate buffers. It contains function declarations for creating a delta index, generating deltas, patching buffers, and utility macros related to delta sizes.

methods.name: create_delta_index
methods.description: Computes an index data structure from a given buffer for delta operations.

methods.name: free_delta_index
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a delta index created by create_delta_index.

methods.name: sizeof_delta_index
methods.description: Returns the memory usage of a delta index.

methods.name: create_delta
methods.description: Creates a delta from a given index and buffer, possibly limited by max delta size.

methods.name: patch_delta
methods.description: Recreates the target buffer from a source buffer and a delta buffer.

methods.name: unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char ** datap,const unsigned char * top)
methods.description: Reads the delta header to determine source and target buffer sizes, used twice on delta data.

methods.name: void * diff_delta(const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)

ctags.name: diff_delta
ctags.signature: (const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_bufsize,const void * trg_buf,unsigned long trg_bufsize,unsigned long * delta_size,unsigned long max_delta_size)

ctags.name: get_delta_hdr_size
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned long get_delta_hdr_size(const unsigned char **datap,$/
ctags.signature: (const unsigned char ** datap,const unsigned char * top)
